meta.source: PointCamp Korea 2027 reel (paper collage), Korea_2027.pdf; Kyiv Type Sans from the PointCamp Japan system

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground everywhere, always with the paper-tile texture on top. The beige of the reel.

tokens.name: paper-light
tokens.usage: The torn white border around photos; quiet alternate section ground.

tokens.name: sticker
tokens.usage: Paper labels, cards, inputs, FAQ rows. Text on it: ink or ink-soft.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All headlines, body text and the Korean display words, on paper, paper-light, sticker, lime and sakura (14.9:1 on paper). Fill of the ink button and ink label.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary body text and captions on paper (7.5:1) and sticker (9.4:1). Never for headlines.

tokens.name: ink-line
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders, FAQ dividers that carry meaning (3.1:1 on paper, 3.9:1 on sticker).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only (section rules on paper). Too light to mark a control.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The one loud hue: spray behind the slogan, the lime label, the primary CTA fill, highlight underlines. Text on it is ink (14.8:1). At most one lime area per screen.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and borders on lime.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Hand-drawn notes, arrows and circles. Text in it only at 28px+ in Caveat with the white outline (3.5:1 on paper, 4.4:1 on sticker).

tokens.name: marker-deep
tokens.usage: Small red text: form errors, «оплачується окремо» notes (4.7:1 on paper, 5.9:1 on sticker).

tokens.name: stamp
tokens.usage: Ink of the round and rectangular rubber stamps. Large text only (4.2:1 on paper).

tokens.name: sakura
tokens.usage: Sakura sticker petals and the pink heart. Spring accent; ink text on it (11:1) only in a tag.

tokens.name: sakura-deep
tokens.usage: Outline of the sakura sticker. Not for text.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Smiley sticker face only.

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: Translucent masking tape over the top edge of a photo.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid, 3px offset, on every interactive element (14.9:1 on paper, 14.8:1 on lime).

styles.name: kr-display
styles.usage: The Korean word on top of a hero or city section. Hangul only (the face has no Cyrillic). 96px under 640px.

styles.name: city
styles.usage: The Ukrainian city word under its Korean pair. Uppercase, Kyiv Type Sans at its heaviest. 64px under 640px.

styles.name: slogan
styles.usage: Latin slogan on the lime spray. Once per page (hero or final CTA). 64px under 640px.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Повне занурення у світ дорам, K-pop, футуристичних технологій та стародавніх традицій.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Одягаємо ханбоки та вирушаємо на фотосесію до палацу Gyeongbokgung.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Переліт 900–1200 €, оформлення візи та кишенькові оплачуються окремо.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Paper labels, eyebrows and buttons. Uppercase.

styles.name: note-lg
styles.usage: Marker note next to a hero photo, in marker with the white outline.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Marker note in a section header. Never below 28px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag gap, label padding block.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Torn photo border, input padding block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside small cards, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gap on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photos, paper labels, stamps: paper is cut, not rounded.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, FAQ rows.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags only.

tokens.name: shadow-photo
tokens.usage: Torn photos (as filter: drop-shadow). Copied from the reel.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Labels, stickers, stamps-free paper bits (as drop-shadow).

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards: a hard ink offset, like a cut-out pasted on.

tilt.note: Rotation for collage pieces. More than tilt-max reads as mess.

tokens.name: tilt-content
tokens.usage: Cards and photos that carry text people must read.

tokens.name: tilt-accent
tokens.usage: Labels, notes, decorative photos.

tokens.name: tilt-max
tokens.usage: Stickers and stamps only.
